reference_rules: Each reference is a hand-verified transcription of everything a reader sees on the scoped pages, in reading order (multi-column: each column top to bottom, left to right; tables: row by row, cells left to right; running header first). Text inside content images is included (the sample's banner and handwriting, the scanned page); logos, seals and invisible (white) text are not. Line-end hyphens and URLs broken across lines are kept as printed, with the break as one space. Line breaks are otherwise not significant: scoring collapses all whitespace.
